targets.name: app
targets.cmd: bun build src/index.ts --target=bun --outfile=$out/lib/app.js && mkdir -p $out/bin && printf '#!%s\nexec %s %s/lib/app.js "$@"\n' "$(command -v bash)" "$tool_bun/bin/bun" "$out" > $out/bin/app && chmod +x $out/bin/app && (PORT=20421 timeout 2 bun run src/index.ts > $TMPDIR/run.txt || true) && cat $TMPDIR/run.txt && grep -q 'bun listening' $TMPDIR/run.txt
